description: This file is a test suite script for a Git and Perforce integration that specifically tests handling of wildcards and special characters in filenames during various operations such as clone, add, submit, rename, delete, and keyword scrubbing.

methods.name: start_p4d
methods.description: Starts a Perforce server daemon for testing purposes.

methods.name: test_have_prereq
methods.description: Checks for prerequisites to determine if a test can run.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Sets up cleanup actions after tests are run.

methods.name: cleanup_git
methods.description: Cleans up the git environment after tests.

methods.name: test_path_is_file
methods.description: Verifies that a given path is a file.

methods.name: test_path_is_missing
methods.description: Verifies that a given path is missing (does not exist).

methods.name: test_line_count
methods.description: Checks the number of lines in a file.
